definitions.explanation: A senior military officer rank. In the army and air force, equivalent to lieutenant colonel; in the navy, equivalent to commander. Ranks above major (少佐) and below colonel (大佐).

examples.japanese: {中佐|ちゅうさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The lieutenant colonel explained the operation.

examples.japanese: {中佐|ちゅうさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇格|しょうかく}→昇格：08369_shoukaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{連隊|れんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副官|ふくかん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He was promoted to lieutenant colonel and became the regiment's adjutant.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{陸軍|りくぐん}→陸軍：19089_rikugun⟧{中佐|ちゅうさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{苦悩|くのう}→苦悩：05517_kunou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The protagonist of the movie is an army lieutenant colonel, and his anguish on the battlefield is depicted.

notes:
{中佐|ちゅうさ} is a senior military officer rank, equivalent to lieutenant colonel in the army/air force or commander in the navy.

RANK HIERARCHY ({佐|さ} tier):
- ⟦{少佐|しょうさ}→少佐：18357_shousa⟧: major / lieutenant commander
- {中佐|ちゅうさ}: lieutenant colonel / commander (this word)
- ⟦{大佐|たいさ}→大佐：12660_taisa⟧: colonel / captain (navy)

FORMS:
⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) + {佐|さ} (officer rank). The {佐|さ} tier uses {少|しょう}/⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧/{大|たい} prefixes for junior/middle/senior grades.

USAGE:
A lieutenant colonel typically commands a battalion-sized unit. This word appears frequently in historical accounts, war films, and military-themed fiction. In modern Japanese self-defense forces (⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧), the equivalent rank is ⟦{二等|にとう}→二等：29988_nitou⟧{佐|さ} (2nd-class officer).
